Nice to meet you and thank you for this very thoughtful appeal. I apologize for the delay in responding to you.
I would very much like to request an illustration of my favorite Vtuber, Akua Mizuki (@mzsr_akua). Please excuse the bullet points below.

Facial features, hairstyle, costume...please refer to the reference images (1) to (3) in the URL below.
We will leave the type of hairstyle to you, so please choose one that you like or that you can easily draw.
If you have any questions about the model, please refer to the attached URL from 2:04:21 to 2:20:22.
Background, composition, pose...I will leave it to you to draw what you are comfortable with.
Usage...Tweets with 3Meko's name, ID, and FA tag "Nyahiart" (may be used as a thumbnail, etc.)

Reference image ①...https://imgur.com/a/Q0rK5NW
Reference image②...https://imgur.com/a/0WxF59f
Reference image (3)...https://imgur.com/a/0i05oKA

Sorry for the rambling.
We hope you will consider our proposal.

Hello 3Meko-san, my name is Amaebi.
I was fascinated by the way you draw girls that are too cute, so I would like to make a request!

I would like to ask you to do a FA of a Vtuber, Ebi Tsumugu.

Composition
The costume should be a pink china style maid idol costume.
Her hair color should be red with a light pink inner color. Her hairstyle should be long and fluffy with bangs on both sides and down the front.
Details of the hairstyle and costume can be found at the URL.

Hairstyle and costume URL
https://x.com/kairou269/status/1887149392874131676?s=46&t=AkZ3GtFKlgdI-fcWXQGrPg

Pose, facial expression, and background are left to 3Meko-san.
I would be happy if you could draw the whole body from head to foot.

The drawing may be used by Tsumugu Umebi himself for posting on SNS, or as a thumbnail on his monetized YouTube channel, or for videos, etc. I, Amaegi, may use it for personal use, such as wallpaper.
I, Amaebi, may use it for personal use such as wallpaper.

We would appreciate it if you could send us PSD and PNG files of the image with and without the address and with the background transparent.

Thank you for your consideration.

https://lit.link/kairou269

Nice to meet you, Mr. 3Meko.

Preparing for vtuber
My name is Miku Nekorei.
I saw your illustration on X and wanted to ask you to draw my V illustration.
I am preparing to be a vtuber!

V Character Details
Concept: A cat spirit that descends in the dark of night.

Pink hair, twin-tail hair, cat ears, kyonshi
A little bit young, eyes a little bit pinched
Red eyes for those with eye patch, purple eyes for those without
Heart pupils. Mouth with omega eyes
Two moles are side by side under the purple eyes.
Breast size is about C~D. cups
There is a tail-like belt instead of a cat's tail. (The tail is short, so you don't have to write it in the illustration.)
Please refer to the littlest link for the character image.


Poses for illustrations are left up to me.

Clothing→We would like to wear different costumes than usual, so we would like you to leave it up to us to draw the costumes according to the time of delivery!
Halloween, Christmas, etc. Or, you can leave it up to us.



Usage: Social networking icons, X., YouTube thumbnails, online prints, etc.
If possible, we would appreciate it if you could also provide a transparent background for the individual characters so that we can see their ears and hair.

Thank you in advance for your consideration.
